name: Phu Yen chicken rice
summary: Chicken rice the 6 October 2024 cẩm nang calls less famous than Hội An or Tam Kỳ, and still worth ordering. The bird is lean, yellow, and a little chewy. The food roundup cooks the rice in the boiling broth and eats the plate at breakfast, lunch, dinner, and feasts. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup both describe cơm gà Phú Yên.
texture: The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says the meat is lean, yellow, a little chewy, and sweet. The food roundup says garden chicken, firm and sweet, and rice that is not fried.
taste: The food roundup says the rice is cooked in the chicken broth, so it stays light, fragrant, and sticky, with rau răm and a sweet-sour fish sauce. The cẩm nang serves cucumber, pickled onion, and đồ chua. Both plates stay.
howToEat: A plate of rice and chicken with the pickles. The food roundup eats it at breakfast, lunch, dinner, and at a feast. The cẩm nang points at midday. Hours are Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Lê Thánh Tôn, Lê Trung Kiên, and Phan Đình Phùng are the streets the 6 October 2024 cẩm nang gives. The food roundup also names Ngô Quyền.
seoTitle: Com ga Phu Yen — chicken rice, not the Hoi An plate
seoDescription: Lean yellow chicken with rice cooked in the broth. Less famous than Hoi An or Tam Ky, on the 6 October 2024 cam nang. A price is Check on arrival.
